name: crawlgraph-datasets
what_it_holds: CSV/JSON datasets of domains linking into specific competitor-tool categories (SEO tools 9,687 domains, CRMs 9,910, AI agent frameworks 7,508, fintech apps 12,106), each row carrying a 'CrawlGraph authority score' (0-100) derived from Common Crawl's open hyperlink graph (~120M domains, 4.4B links, refreshed quarterly, queried via DuckDB). Free to reuse with attribution; 4 commits.
why_useful: Demonstrates a working, quarterly-refreshed Common Crawl host-graph authority-score pipeline (queryable via DuckDB, which the team already uses) that could be re-pointed at travel/OTA domains (airbnb.com, booking.com, vrbo.com, expedia.com) to build a backlink-authority proxy for site prominence — marginal fit since the shipped categories are unrelated (SEO/CRM/fintech/AI tools), but the method and data source are directly reusable.
size_hint: 4 CSV/JSON files, several thousand rows each
license: free with attribution (CrawlGraph); underlying data Common Crawl open data
last_activity: 4 commits, recent (Common Crawl quarterly refresh cadence implies 2025-2026 activity)

name: similarweb-scraper-public (name approximate, via Apify)
what_it_holds: Listed on GitHub's 'similarweb' topic as extracting website traffic and ranking data via the Apify scraping platform (i.e., an Apify actor wrapper). Method-only, no committed Similarweb dataset for airbnb.com; relies on Apify's hosted scraper for the live pull.
why_useful: One of several small scrapers indicating Similarweb visit-estimate data (visits, bounce rate, traffic-source mix, top competitors) can be pulled for airbnb.com/booking.com/vrbo.com without a paid Similarweb subscription, feeding gap #5 web-traffic estimates — but per repo rules this is a method to catalogue and NOT run against Similarweb's own terms without a human sign-off (scraping a third-party site, not airbnb.com itself, so lower ToS sensitivity than scraping airbnb.com directly, but still worth a human check).

name: similarweb-traffic-data-python (name approximate)
what_it_holds: Listed on the 'similarweb' GitHub topic as a 'Python scraper for traffic data without subscription' — a method-only repo scraping Similarweb's free public site-overview pages for visit-count estimates, engagement metrics, and top-competitor lists.
why_useful: Same class of value as similarweb-scraper-public: a free-tier method to get Similarweb's visit-estimate/rank numbers for airbnb.com and OTA peers programmatically for gap #5. name: pageviews (Ironholds)
what_it_holds: R client library (24 stars) for the Wikimedia pageview API, from a long-time Wikimedia data engineer; wraps the same REST API as Commonists' Python client but for R users.
why_useful: Alternative-language (R) tooling for the same pageviews-as-proxy approach; useful if the team's stats work is in R rather than Python. Same use case as Commonists/pageview-api.
themes: Wikipedia pageviews tooling and destination-demand datasets (pageviews for cities/attractions as tourism proxies)
